reduced_cases_note: Every common-regime region has reduced rates or bonuses for a main home bought by some groups (young, disabled, large families, low income, victims) and most for protected housing (hacienda-autonomica-2026-cap1). An investor buying to let rarely qualifies; the UI offers 'my rate is different' (a manual rate) instead of encoding each region's conditions.

gestoria_default.note: no official tariff; market range ~300-600 € including VAT; input amounts are totals including VAT

valuation_default.note: appraisal (tasación), paid by the borrower (ley-5-2019 art. 14.1.e.i); market range ~250-600 €; total including VAT

buyer_agency_default.note: in Spain the seller usually pays the agency (custom, not law); configurable
